blends.name: Mandrayke Reborn - WTC SuperBlend game
blends.desc:
**Mandrayke has been turned to stone by powers unknown, you know there is a chance of bringing him back
for without him, the dragons will wreak havock on the realm. 
You acquire a copy of The Codex Arcanum after looting the body of a fallen goblin and decide to study its pages
inside the ancient tome you find a spell called rebirth and you decide to give it a try**

Blending the Codex Arcanum with Mandraykes statue will break him free
from his stoney prison 

**chances for Mandrayke to achieve 5 levels of rarity from common to mythic**

Common       45%
Uncommon   30%
Rare             15%
Legendary      8%
Mythic            2%

you can find the necessary ingredients in the [WIZARDS CRYPT](https://neftyblocks.com/c/wizardscrypt)

 and the superblend link here [MANDRAYKE SUPERBLEND](https://neftyblocks.com/c/wizardscrypt/blends/super)
